verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform that holds sensitive company and shareholder data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack never mentions AI model training, data-use policies or any opt-out control. The data-room access controls cover who can see files, not whether data is used for training, so they do not count as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
